summary: Phase C final pre-publish verification. 8/9 fixes ✅, Fix 8 (Papa company scope) ⚠️ PARTIAL (client-side only; server-side migration still pending on remote host). 200-row stress test 200/200 POST success (parties, shipments, invoices, ledger). Mobile screenshot audit clean — dark base, no hamburger/title overlap, sidebar opaque with no bleed, single-item active highlight. Voice orb, PDF button, smart back-button, catalog broadcast (MOCKED) all verified. Two spec drifts noted: (a) company param sends short form 'singh_exports' not 'co_singh_exports'; (b) catalog endpoint is /wingman/catalog-item not /wingman/catalog-upsert.

minor.issue: Server currently accepts the param (200 OK) but does NOT filter rows server-side — Papa row-level scoping relies on the client sending the param; legacy remote rows have no 'company' column.
Endpoint referenced in spec does not exist. Actual endpoint is /api/wingman/catalog-item. Confirm canonical name.

integration_issues.issue: company-context.tsx strips 'co_' prefix and sends '?company=singh_exports', not '?company=co_singh_exports' as spec text states.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web deprecation warnings at runtime (not from these fixes but noted). Migrate to boxShadow / textShadow. Reference: multiple files including sidebar.tsx and voice-orb.tsx (native shadowColor/shadowOpacity fallbacks).
Deprecation warning — use style.pointerEvents instead. Reference: voice-orb.tsx top-level Animated.View.

action_items: Coordinate remote-host migration to add 'company' column on shipments/invoices/ledger for real Papa server-side row-level scoping (Fix 8).
Reconcile spec: company param wire format — currently 'singh_exports' short form; spec expects 'co_singh_exports'. Either update spec or restore prefix in company-context.tsx.
Reconcile spec: rename Wingman endpoint to /catalog-upsert OR update Phase C spec to /catalog-item.
Wire real WhatsApp Business API credentials (WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID) so the currently MOCKED broadcast queue actually delivers.
Track RN Web shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings for a future style-props migration.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side company filter is a client-side concern only — a savvy user could remove the query param and see all rows. Once schema migration lands, server MUST enforce the filter from the JWT.
MongoDB ObjectId handled correctly via _clean_mongo_id() in server.py — no bleed.

pytest-xdist splits tests across workers so module-scoped CREATED dict can lose data. Follow-up manual sweep confirmed cleanup complete but the built-in cleanup path is fragile — consider per-test class fixture with autouse teardown.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 50 parties + 50 shipments + 50 invoices + 50 ledger entries prefixed 'TEST_' via public API as kishan. All 200 rows deleted after verification; baseline counts restored (shipments=5, invoices=2, parties=17).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phaseC_final.py is reusable — asserts login, wingman health, catalog broadcast log endpoint, papa scope, FY filter, and 200-row stress with cleanup. Fixture 'CREATED' is module-scoped so must run in one session (single -k selector or full file). If shipments/invoices cleanup shows incomplete, run the manual sweep in /app/test_reports/phaseC_final.md 'Cleanup' section. Note that when running with pytest-xdist (default), all tests currently run on worker gw0 due to LoadScopeScheduling — so cleanup works as long as CREATED persists.
rca_of_issue: Fix 8 (Papa server-side scope) is intentionally PARTIAL per Phase C spec — server accepts the ?company= param but does not filter rows because legacy rows on the REMOTE_BACKEND_URL host lack the 'company' column. Full fix requires a schema migration on the remote host. Client-side scoping is in place via company-context.tsx forcing user.company for non-Admins.
